structure.heading: Regulatory Obligation-to-Control Coverage and Ownership Status
text_content: As of 2026-05-01, 42 of 48 obligations (87.5%) are mapped to at least one internal control, reflecting substantial coverage of the current regulatory inventory. Six obligations remain unmapped and are prioritized for assignment during the next control design cycle. Mapping status is tracked in the central compliance registry with last update timestamp 2026-05-01. An exception list is maintained for legacy requirements pending technical design; target assignment deadlines are set by control domain owners now.

The compliance map documents specific control ownership for critical standards. PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 8.3.1 is mapped to control IAM-02 (MFA for privileged access) owned by Alex Rivera. GLBA Safeguards Rule 16 CFR 314.4(d) is mapped to control SEC-07 (Encryption key management) owned by Priya Nair. These mappings include control descriptions, implemented evidence, and testing procedures. Owner contact information and last test dates are recorded to support auditability and remediation tracking.

Control ownership and remediation tracking operate through governance with escalation to the Chief Compliance Officer for overdue items. Each control owner maintains a remediation plan with target closure dates, status updates, and risk ratings; progress against target dates is reported in the quarterly compliance dashboard. For the six unmapped obligations, compensating controls are evaluated and owners will be assigned by 2026-06-15. Evidence packages are retained to demonstrate remediation and closure once testing confirms effectiveness.
